sources.title: New Knoy rooftop solar array generates more power, learning opportunities and research
sources.feature_identifier: Knoy Hall / Applied Energy Laboratory rooftop PV installation
facts_used: Purdue reports a 28-panel array installed on the Knoy roof, replacing a 24-panel array installed 17 years earlier.
The article links installation photographs and describes the panel support rack.
The report confirms the historical 2017 panel count, not the array's unchanged status in 2026.
sources.model_application: Replaced the prior speculative 90-panel array with 28 discrete modeled modules in a schematic 4x7 arrangement. Kept the prior roof-zone center. Added visually separate metal support rails.
sources.uncertainty: The article provides no measured roof plan, exact panel layout/orientation/position, array tilt, support-member dimensions, or current 2026 survey. The 4x7 pattern, tilt and retained center are estimates.

sources.title: Knoy Hall first on campus to use solar power
facts_used: Reports PV panels on Knoy Hall's roof, grid tied in 2013, and states that the installation had been present since 2000.
Establishes that rooftop PV is a repeated historic building feature; it does not establish the current array geometry.
sources.uncertainty: No current/as-built geometry or current system persistence is documented by this 2013 article.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.title: Knoy Hall of Technology records, UA 141
sources.source_date: Collection dates to 1984; finding aid published 2017-10-09
facts_used: Finding aid says the folder contains construction information and a floor plan.
sources.measurement_method: Finding aid review only; the physical folder was not inspected during this task.
sources.uncertainty: Potential primary plans are not digitized in the cited record. The listed floor plan may not include elevations or roof equipment.

sources.provider: Purdue University College of Engineering / Purdue Gateway planning study
sources.title: Serpentine: Knoy Hall Connection — Massing Studies Draft Including Landscape
sources.feature_identifier: PDF page 24, Existing Knoy Elevations; adjacent Typical Plan Levels 2-4
facts_used: Existing Knoy elevations label Levels 1-4 and state a 14 ft 8 in floor-to-floor height.
The existing typical plan is a useful L2-L4 plan source but is not a current surveyed/as-built document.
sources.measurement_method: Read the printed vertical interval and compared it to modeled L1-L4 datum values recorded in the source asset. Modeled intervals are 4.481, 4.480 and 4.481 m; the printed 14 ft 8 in converts to 4.4704 m, giving 0.0096-0.0106 m differences.
sources.uncertainty: The sheet is a planning study, not an as-built survey; it labels only existing Levels 1-4 and does not resolve modeled L5, the roof deck, parapet, or penthouse.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives / Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database
sources.title: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology building record
sources.source_date: Record states built 1985; database citation references the 2019 historical building record
facts_used: Identifies Knoy Hall and notes that it has photovoltaic arrays on its roof.
sources.uncertainty: Historical description, not a current roof survey or dimensions source.

sources.title: Official profile photo featuring Knoy Hall
sources.feature_identifier: Knoy Hall entrance/facade photo used as a Purdue profile image
facts_used: A current Purdue-hosted photo provides a facade reference for red brick, glazing, entrance signage, canopy and surrounding planting.
sources.measurement_method: Qualitative visual comparison only; the single perspective is uncalibrated and does not establish building dimensions, full facade rhythm, or floor elevations.
sources.uncertainty: No dated calibrated elevation or dimensioned facade source was found in this review; no exterior facade geometry was changed.

model_changes: Changed the Knoy asset's solar panel geometry from 90 speculative modules to 28 modules, matching Purdue's published 2017 installation count.
Added panel-count/source/estimate metadata to the solar array object and scene.
Added an independently visible schematic metal support frame and a roof close-up audit view.
Tagged the existing penthouse as an unverified schematic placeholder without changing its geometry.
Did not add cooling-tower geometry because the inspected sources did not establish its presence or dimensions and the current reopened asset has no cooling-tower object.
Retained the L5 and roof geometry; documented the L1-L4 vertical interval comparison and the L5/roof source conflict.
unresolved: Current roof layout and 2026 PV persistence are unverified.
Penthouse presence, dimensions, and placement remain unverified.
No source located for rooftop cooling towers; none modeled.
GIS attributes report five levels and 48 ft extrusion, but do not resolve the 2018 planning sheet's L1-L4 story labeling or the modeled L5/roof arrangement.
Facade photo is qualitative; exact elevation, window/band dimensions and facade rhythm remain unverified.
